items: Creatures' attacks are magic now, each in its element: fire bursts into flame, frost shatters, venom splashes, storm crackles, earth throws rubble, shadow implodes, bloom bursts into petals, moonlight rings
Every wild attack warns you the same way, whatever its element: white marching dashes edged in dark (a lane, a landing ring, a beam's line going solid), flashing just before it lands
Slowed creatures wear chains, stunned ones stars, and her confusion is a spiral
